## Important
- app/planner.py:9 — correctness — Emit each adoption message only once — With `run({"theme": "dark"}, {"theme": "dark"}, emit)`, the command emits `Adopted theme` twice. Your new record reaches the renderer at `app/cli.py:6–9` after the planner already emits the message at line 8. — When an incoming setting already exists, users receive duplicate progress messages for a single adoption. — Fix: Preserve planner progress and returned adoption records, skip adoption records during command rendering, and extend coverage through `run`.
